primary_risk: Dependence on a few large customers
sector_survival_note: ASML has consistently demonstrated its ability to innovate and adapt to changing market conditions.
thesis_summary: ASML provides cutting-edge lithography technology that enables the production of smaller, more complex semiconductors, riding the trend of increasing demand for AI and high-performance computing.
thesis_breaks_if: A structural shift in the semiconductor industry that renders lithography technology obsolete.
sentiment_note: Richly valued, but a great company with a strong moat and durable business model.
ten_k_highlights: ASML has a strong track record of innovation and has consistently demonstrated its ability to adapt to changing market conditions.
The company's lithography technology is a critical component of the semiconductor manufacturing process and is essential for the production of smaller, more complex semiconductors.
ASML's business model is highly scalable, and the company has a strong track record of delivering revenue growth and expanding its gross margin.
valuation_note: FCF yield 1.4%, PEG 2.2, EV/EBITDA 52, P/S 20 — very richly valued — starter position only.
implied_growth_note: The price already assumes strong growth for a decade — accumulate slowly.
